name: JBM Auto Ltd.
about: JBM Auto Limited engages in the manufacture and sale sheet metal components, tools, dies and moulds, and buses in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Sheet Metal Components, Assemblies & Sub-assemblies (Component Division); Tool, Dies & Moulds (Tool Room Division); and OEM Division. The company offers auto components and systems, such as BIW, chassis and suspension systems, pedal boxes, tubular products, safety-critical components, and various auto assemblies for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and farm and construction equipment. It also provides electric buses; lithium ion batteries solutions for HV- LV battery operated vehicle, energy storage systems, and solar; and operates electric vehicles charging infrastructure. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~28% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~19% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 49 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 88), though that is a short history to judge by.
PE 49 is 34% above the sector median, but its ROCE and growth largely justify that premium.
High leverage (D/E 2.0x) raises risk; equity value is sensitive to interest costs.
